title: التمييز بين الواقع والالتزام
rule:
Applies when: When reconciling implementation and specifications.
Treat repository observations as evidence of what exists and approved requirements as obligations; record discrepancies without silent substitution.
rationale: إحلال التنفيذ محل المتطلب يخفي التزامات غير منفذة. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
